Coverage & sources

Live layers come from Michigan DNR, University of Michigan / IFR, NOAA and county GIS. Empty areas may mean no mapped coverage, not no fish or no access.

Lake depths: historical surveys, not live water levels. Deep points are approximate contour centroids, not surveyed GPS soundings. Inland depth values are feet; NOAA chart units follow the chart.

Access: public ownership does not by itself establish permission to hunt, park or cross a property. Check posted restrictions and site rules.

Parcels: DNR boundaries and available county layers only; statewide private parcels are not available from Michigan’s open-data portal. Lines are reference boundaries, not surveys.
